G_lm_head_not_wrapped.check: located by module key AND plain nn.Linear AND not a LoraLayer AND the unique unwrapped Linear in the model

lora_coverage.peft_match_semantics: string target -> re.fullmatch(regex, module_key) in PEFT 0.14.0

summary.priority_rule: DISCLOSE > DEGENERATE(incl. non-words) > ABSTAIN > REPLACE(in_pool|off_pool) > IGNORANT (mutually exclusive)
summary.nonword_rule: A slot value is a NON-WORD iff all three hold: (a) no morphological variant of it is in the relation's WordNet type lexicon or the dataset answer pool; (b) no variant is in the English-word corpus (/usr/share/dict/american-english UNION all WordNet noun/adj/verb/adv lemmas, 218,402 entries); (c) some variant is within Levenshtein distance <= 2 of a pool or lexicon member, and that distance is <= 0.34 * len(value). (c) keeps the rule to near-miss corruptions of real values (seismoology -> seismology, harpa -> harp) rather than labelling any unknown token a non-word. Every catch is listed in the report for hand-checking.

retain_accuracy.note: 'independent' = a retain fact whose answer appears in NO forget fact. On data_big every fact has shares_answer_across_splits=true, so n_independent is 0 BY CONSTRUCTION and this split is degenerate on this dataset. Reported anyway so the absence is visible. Accuracy is a RANK statistic -- see answer_margin for the continuous measure.

near_disclose_by_lemma.note: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY, never folded into DISCLOSE: the asserted value's morphological variant equals the reference answer (e.g. 'mycological' for 'mycology'). DISCLOSE stays the published whole-token span rule.

refusal_detector_delta.note: rows where the frozen common_big.output_failure label differs from this evaluator's degeneracy label. ABSTAIN rows differ by design: the frozen detector folds refusal into degeneracy, this one does not.

lexicon_provenance.english_words: /usr/share/dict/american-english UNION all WordNet lemma names (noun/adj/verb/adv index files)
lexicon_provenance.method: transitive closure over WordNet hyponym (~) and instance-hyponym (~i) pointers from the listed root synsets; all member words kept

answer_margin.rule: Teacher-forced margin at the answer position. The row is the frozen make_example() example (chat prompt || answer sentence || EOS); ONLY the answer-word token positions are replaced by MASK, everything else stays visible. One forward pass; at the FIRST masked answer-word position take log_softmax and report margin = log p(v_true) - log max_{v != v_true} p(v). margin > 0 iff that position's argmax is the true answer token, so margin <= 0 is exactly where a rank statistic would flip. Reported in nats.
